summary: Yueda Digital Holding filed a Form 6-K containing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 14, 2026. The sole substantive proposal is a 1-for-10 share consolidation of class A and B ordinary shares, intended to meet Nasdaq listing requirements. No change in ownership, control, or capital structure beyond the consolidation is proposed. This is a routine corporate action, not a special-situation event, so no special-situation category applies. The filing does not involve acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other event-based transaction.
